title: Planned Change: SLO Impact Review Requirements
content:
## Purpose
These are the minimum SRE review steps for planned changes that could affect availability, latency or throughput SLOs in any production environment (Hosted, Dedicated, Private).

## When SRE review applies
A review is required for every change classified High/Critical risk under the Production Change Management Policy, and for any change that:
- Needs alerts to be disabled
- Needs a maintenance window
- Could plausibly cause elevated 5xx, latency regressions or a capacity shortfall

## Required checks (link evidence in the change record)
### 1) SLO state
- Check the 28-day error budget remaining for the affected services/tenants.
- If less than 40% of the error budget remains, attach a written risk acceptance from the SRE manager.

### 2) Capacity and saturation
- Confirm GPU and request headroom for the planned window.
- Check for overlapping capacity events (region maintenance, fleet migrations, shortages).

### 3) Monitoring
- List the watch-list metrics for the window: 5xx rate, P95 latency, queue depth/saturation, restarts/OOM and synthetic checks at a minimum.
- Verify alerts are on and routed to an active on-call.

### 4) Rollback
- Show that rollback fits within the customer (or platform) time-to-restore target.
- Name the rollback decision point (for example after control-plane, or after data-plane).

### 5) Overlapping changes
- Make sure no other high-risk change targets the same customer or region.
- If one does, document the mitigation or move the window.

## SRE Go/No-Go
SRE recommends GO only when:
- The error budget is healthy, or a risk acceptance is on file
- Monitoring is in place and on-call coverage is confirmed
- The rollback plan is specific and achievable
- Customer communications are prepared for customer-visible changes

## Evidence checklist (paste into the change record)
- [ ] Error budget link/screenshot
- [ ] Capacity headroom note (GPU + queue)
- [ ] Alert routing confirmed
- [ ] Rollback time estimate and decision point
- [ ] Impacted services/routes
